# nexspence_replication_rule (Resource)

A push-replication rule that copies artifacts from a local repository to a remote Nexspence instance on a cron schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Push artifacts from a local repo to a remote Nexspence instance every night.
resource "nexspence_replication_rule" "to_dr" {
  name            = "to-dr"
  source_repo     = "maven-releases"
  target_url      = "https://nexspence-dr.example.com"
  target_repo     = "maven-releases"
  target_username = "repl"
  target_password = var.repl_password
  cron_expr       = "0 2 * * *"
  enabled         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `source_repo` (String) Local repository name to push from.
- `target_repo` (String) Repository name on the remote instance.
- `target_url` (String) Base URL of the remote Nexspence instance.

### Optional

- `cron_expr` (String) Standard cron schedule. Empty means manual-only; the server default is nightly 02:00.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `target_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the remote instance. Write-only — the API never returns it.
- `target_username` (String) Username used to authenticate to the remote instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_run_at` (String) Timestamp of the last run, if any.
- `last_run_status` (String) ok, error, running, or empty.
